sn7.10:1.1: Contrast this vivid description of the woes of the rural life with the satisfaction of the wealthy rancher at [snp1.2]().
sn7.10:5.2: For _santhāra_ as “mat” or “carpet” (rather than “blanket”) see [sn35.243:2.1](), [an6.16:2.5](), [an3.35:2.1](), [an3.126:3.7](), etc.
sn7.10:6.3: All of whom would have been dependent on their father.
sn7.10:9.1: The Buddha appropriates and transforms the brahmin’s accusations, an early example of reclaiming language to see the “glass half full”.
